findings.title: CodeQL js/insufficient-password-hash on OAuth state lookup in archived local harness

normalized_input.claimed_source: CodeQL labels the return value from oauth() as a password
normalized_input.claimed_control: Password hashing lacks a computationally expensive password KDF
normalized_input.affected_version_or_path: PR #151 merge ref eba1033f3f636b61c900b6a62a06ba6408c37daa; local head 1a656e462387a19faf148019b8f8f37923828b30
preconditions: Input must actually be a human password and its fast digest used as a password verifier
normalized_input.impact: Offline password cracking if the premise were true

affected_locations.label: reported sink
affected_locations.detail: SHA-256 helper is invoked for a synthetic browser verifier and returned OAuth state, not account passwords

affected_locations.label: actual source
affected_locations.detail: oauth_start response r.data.data.state flows through start() into SQL state_hash lookup assertions

affected_locations.label: server generation
affected_locations.detail: state is base64Url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32))); database stores digest(state) for single-use OAuth transaction

reachable_path: hash(state) at lines 90 and 95 used only for querying google_calendar_oauth_states.state_hash

boundary_assessment.policy_basis: Root SECURITY.md requires actual source/boundary evidence and forbids excluding an alert only because it is in tests/docs. The claim is defeated by the data being a 32-byte random OAuth state, not by its directory.

exploitability_stack_rank.rationale: The reported source is not a password and the digest is not an account password verifier.

evidence: SARIF analysis 2142661749 has two flows, both from oauth_start response state through lines 90/95 to line 23.
Local head and reported PR merge artifact contain the same affected harness lines.
Application oauth_start generates 32 random bytes and separately stores state_hash; token/browser verification is independent.
counterevidence: Actual synthetic account passwords are sent to GoTrue password login; no account password reaches this hash helper.
Changing SHA-256 to a password KDF here would break equality with the implemented state_hash representation without improving account-password storage.
No global CodeQL exclusion, severity reduction, hashing algorithm change or application code change is proposed.
proof_gaps: Static assessment only for alert #67; not a new runtime test or blanket assessment of password security.
findings.recommended_next_step: Dismiss only alert 67 as false positive with this dataflow evidence, then verify CodeQL result check and required CI before merge.
